items.title: 17.13 RLC parallel circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: RLC parallel circuit mein resistor, inductor aur capacitor ek doosre ke parallel AC source se jure hote hain (Fig. 17.12(a)). Parallel jorne se kul impedance aur current ki taqseem (har shaakh mein kitna current) badal jati hai, is liye yeh series circuit se alag hai.
RLC parallel circuit ki khaas baatein
1. Resonance aur impedance: parallel RLC circuit X_L = X_C par resonate karta hai. Us waqt impedance sab se zyada hoti hai aur circuit sirf resistor wale circuit jaisa bartao karta hai. Impedance:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Parallel mein resistances ki tarah ulte (1/R, 1/X) jama hote hain. Resonance par 1/X_L − 1/X_C = 0 ho jata hai, is liye Z = R (sab se zyada). Kitab is equation ko bhi 17.27 number deti hai, jo 17.12 mein P = VI cos θ ka number bhi hai.

2. Voltage aur current: parallel circuit mein har hisse par voltage ek hi hota hai, is liye voltage ko reference phasor lete hain. Resonance par source se aane wala current sab se kam hota hai, lekin shaakhon (branches) ke andar current bohat bara ho sakta hai; is liye ise current magnification (current barhane) ke liye istemal kar sakte hain. Frequency ke saath current ka badalna Fig. 17.12(b) mein hai. Resonance par shaakh currents I_L aur I_C dono resonance current Iᵣ se bare ho sakte hain.

blocks.alt: (a) AC source ke aar-paar parallel jure R, L aur C; line current I oopar ki taar mein aur neeche se wapas, aur shaakh currents IR, IL aur IC teen shaakhon se neeche. (b) Current I aur frequency: hamwar U-numa lakeer jis ka sab se nichla nuqta, resonance current Ir, resonance frequency fr par hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.12 (a), (b): (a) AC source se jura RLC parallel circuit; (b) resonance frequency aur resonance current Ir ka graph (kitab ki Figure 17.12 (a), (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Parallel circuit mein resonance par impedance sab se zyada hoti hai, is liye line current I sab se kam (Iᵣ) hota hai: graph neeche ki taraf jhukta hai. Series circuit mein ulat hai: wahan resonance par current sab se zyada hota hai (Fig. 17.11(d)).
3. Admittance: admittance (Y) impedance ka ulta (Y = 1/Z) hai; parallel circuits samajhne mein kaam aata hai. Parallel RLC circuit ka kul admittance har hisse ke admittance ka jama (sum) hai.

4. Frequency aur bandwidth: parallel RLC circuit mein impedance, admittance aur currents sab frequency par munhasir hain. Bandwidth frequencies ki woh range hai jis mein circuit theek kaam karta hai. Resonance frequency:

Parallel RLC circuit tuning circuits, signal processing aur power systems mein bhi istemal hota hai. Induction cooktop (bijli ka chulha) mein bhi: parallel RLC circuit coil mein zyada frequency ka current banata hai, jo dhaat (metal) ke bartan mein current paida karta hai aur bartan garam ho jata hai (Fig. 17.12(c), kitab mein tasveer).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Electrocardiogram (ECG) dil ki bimariyon ki pehchan mein kaam aata hai: dil dharakte waqt jo chhoti chhoti bijli ki lehrein (electric waves) banti hain, unhein record kar ke CRO (screen) par dekha jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab box mein naam 'ECTR OCARDIO GRAM' chhapti hai; sahi naam ELECTROCARDIOGRAM (ECG) hai.

5. Quality factor (Q): Q batata hai ke resonance ki choti (peak) kitni tez (sharp) hai, aur circuit mein jama energy, kharch hone wali energy ke muqable mein kitni hai. Parallel RLC circuit mein Q resistance R ke seedha mutabiq (directly proportional) hai: Q = R√(C/L).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke parallel RLC circuit mein Q resistance ke ulta mutabiq (inversely proportional) hai. Sahi: parallel circuit mein Q = R√(C/L), yani R barhe to Q barhta hai. Ulta taluq series circuit ka hai, jahan Q = (1/R)√(L/C).
6. Power factor: parallel RLC circuit ka power factor frequency aur X_L aur X_C ki miqdar par munhasir hai. Resonance par power factor 1 (unity) hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Resonance par series aur parallel RLC circuits mein source ke current mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Series circuit mein impedance sab se kam (Z = R), is liye current sab se zyada; parallel circuit mein impedance sab se zyada, is liye source (line) current sab se kam.

items: Parallel RLC: har shaakh par ek hi voltage; Z = 1/√((1/R)² + (1/X_L − 1/X_C)²).
Resonance (X_L = X_C): Z sab se zyada, source current sab se kam; fᵣ = 1/(2π√LC).
Admittance Y = 1/Z; istemal: tuning, induction cooktop.
